# Bareun Integrative Medical Insight Journal & 3D Anatomy Portal
> Evidence-based health insight journal citing international biomedical literature (Nature Medicine, NEJM, The Lancet, JAMA, Physiological Reviews, European Heart Journal, JCEM, Human Reproduction Update, European Urology) alongside integrative physiology, paired with an interactive 3D Human Anatomy Clinic Explorer and a members-only private Disease Q&A hub.

## Flagship Medical Insight Column (Single Representative Publication)
- [만성 피로·소화 장애·척추 통증은 왜 함께 찾아오는가: 해외 의학 논문으로 읽는 자율신경·장-뇌 축·생체역학 통합 가이드](https://www.bareunhaniwon.com/integrative-autonomic-circadian-gut-spine-health-review/): Comprehensive systems-biology review of Systemic Chronic Inflammation (Nature Medicine 2019), Microbiota-Gut-Brain Axis (Physiological Reviews 2019), Spinal Biomechanics (The Lancet 2018, JAMA 2017), Vasovagal Syncope (ESC 2018), Brown Adipose Thermogenesis (NEJM 2009), and Circadian Slow-Wave Sleep Growth/Reproductive/Urinary physiology.

## Core Interactive Portals
- [3D Full-Screen Human Anatomy & Clinic Motion Explorer](https://www.bareunhaniwon.com/body-explorer/): Interactive WebGL 3D body model with real-time anatomical graphic motion, cascading clinic navigation, lifestyle DO/DON'T protocols, and international SCI paper summaries.
- [Expert Medical Insight Journal](https://www.bareunhaniwon.com/ask-doctor/?tab=blog): Non-promotional, evidence-based medical review hub.
- [Disease-Specific 1:1 Private Q&A Hub](https://www.bareunhaniwon.com/ask-doctor/?tab=qna): Members-only strictly private Q&A categorized across 9 clinical domains (fast signup via Google, KakaoTalk, Naver).
